sources.name: L.L.Bean
sources.optout_instructions: Use account Catalog Settings or contact L.L.Bean directly to remove your name from the postal catalog list. Merchant says third-party opt-out services are not honored.
sources.notes: Official page accepts U.S. addresses.

sources.name: King Arthur Baking
sources.optout_instructions: Under Catalogs & Printed Mail, use the linked preferences form or phone (800) 777-4434 to change frequency or remove all printed mailings.
sources.notes: Free printed catalog signup.

sources.name: Breck's
sources.optout_instructions: Contact customer service and request an end to PRINTED catalogs. Include your name, full postal address and any account number. Site lists (513) 354-1512 and service@brecks.com.
sources.notes: Free catalog; no purchase needed.

sources.name: Johnny's Selected Seeds
sources.optout_instructions: Ask to be removed from PHYSICAL catalog mailings through mail, phone, chat or email, as specified in the privacy policy. Main service: 877-564-6697.
sources.notes: Request form requires email and phone; deselect optional electronic newsletter.

sources.name: Stauer
sources.optout_instructions: Use Stauer customer service to request removal from PRINTED mailings, as described under FAQ > Changes to information.
sources.notes: Form requests email and phone. Do not select optional email-marketing checkbox.

sources.name: Oriental Trading
sources.optout_instructions: Request removal from PHYSICAL catalog mailing lists through the published catalog list contact process; phone 1-800-348-6483 is also specified in the privacy policy.
sources.notes: Request one catalog using the official form; optional email-promotions checkbox must remain unchecked. Catalog selections may vary.

sources.name: The Vermont Country Store
sources.optout_instructions: Ask Live Help Chat or call 1-802-776-5644 to remove your complete postal address from PRINTED catalog mailings; privacy policy also specifies customerservice@vermontcountrystore.com.
sources.notes: Free print catalog; unsubscribe may take time to affect already-prepared mailings.

sources.name: Gurney's Seed & Nursery
sources.optout_instructions: For PRINTED catalog removal email service@gurneys.com with first/last name, mailing address, city, state, ZIP, and account number if known, exactly as stated on the catalog request page.
sources.notes: The same official page contains free catalog request and print-catalog unsubscribe instructions.

sources.name: Orvis
sources.optout_instructions: Orvis explicitly offers change/cancellation of PAPER catalog mailings in its privacy policy. If its linked form fails, contact customer service at 888-235-9763 or customerservice@orvis.com.
sources.notes: Orvis catalog-request page is client-rendered; verify it still provides a PRINTED catalog form, not email signup.

sources.name: Pottery Barn (including Kids/Teen)
sources.optout_instructions: Select "Unsubscribe from all catalog mailings" on the official Catalog Mailing Options form and enter the recipient information as printed on the mailing label.
sources.notes: One official form offers Pottery Barn, Kids and Teen; one source record avoids duplicate requests to the same operator.

sources.name: Uline
sources.optout_instructions: Use Uline Customize Mailing to REMOVE the address from PHYSICAL catalog mailings; Uline warns catalogs may continue 6-8 weeks due to production lead times.
sources.notes: Free catalogs; personal account type is available; do not misstate affiliation with a business.

sources.name: The Swiss Colony
sources.optout_instructions: To stop PRINTED promotional catalogs, call 866-212-5361; the official privacy policy expressly publishes this route.
sources.notes: Free seasonal food-gift catalog; credit application/purchase is not necessary and must never be initiated.

sources.name: Today Daily Devotional (ReFrame)
sources.optout_instructions: Cancel the FREE print devotional on the dedicated official print-cancellation form; if available provide the subscription PID from your issue mailing label.
sources.notes: Select the FREE pocket edition, not the donation-suggested large-print edition. Optional donations must not be submitted.

sources.name: Theology Matters
sources.optout_instructions: To stop the FREE quarterly printed journal, email admin@theologymatters.com with the recipient name and printed mailing address, as specified on the subscription page.
sources.notes: Free quarterly printed theological journal; no purchase or membership required.

sources.name: Nazarene Compassionate Ministries Magazine
sources.optout_instructions: Email info@ncm.org or call 800-310-6362 and specifically request cancellation of the PHYSICAL NCM magazine, as published in the NCM FAQs.
sources.notes: Choose INDIVIDUAL PAPER subscription, not bulk church order or digital email signup. CAPTCHA must be done manually.

sources.name: In Touch Monthly Devotional
sources.optout_instructions: For postal mailings, In Touch privacy policy explicitly says to request removal via its contact information or customer-care phone 800-789-1473; specify the monthly PRINT devotional.
sources.notes: Choose Print Mail, not Daily Devotions Email or electronic newsletter; page may include broader communications consent.

sources.name: In Touch - From the Pastor's Heart
sources.optout_instructions: For physical mail removal, contact In Touch at the published contact address or 800-789-1473, specifically naming From the Pastor's Heart printed monthly letter.
sources.notes: Free monthly U.S.-only postal letter. Same ministry as In Touch devotional: ask to cancel only the named print product if others should continue.

sources.name: In Touch Sermon Companion
sources.optout_instructions: Request removal of the U.S. PRINT Sermon Companion using In Touch published postal opt-out channel, including customer care 800-789-1473.
sources.notes: Separate print publication from the same ministry; specify source explicitly on cancellation. Shipping can take 6-8 weeks.

sources.name: Institute for Creation Research Publications
sources.optout_instructions: For changes/cancellation of PRINT Acts & Facts or Days of Praise, contact subscriptions@icr.org or phone 800-337-0375 (Subscriptions Department).
sources.notes: Free print selections Acts & Facts (nine issues/year) and Days of Praise (quarterly). Explicitly select Print and None for email newsletter choices.

sources.name: Tyndale House - World of the Bible (U.S.)
sources.optout_instructions: For U.S. PRINT subscription address changes or cancellation, contact American Friends of Tyndale House at info@friendsoftyndalehouse.com as the official subscription page instructs.
sources.notes: Select the World of the Bible US print option (two free mailed issues/year), not UK or email newsletter.

sources.name: Tomorrow's World Magazine
sources.optout_instructions: Cancel the free PRINT magazine by contacting the publisher via its official contact form, email privacy@lcg.org or U.S. telephone +1 704-844-1962.
sources.notes: Choose Free TW Magazine subscription on the official free literature form, not digital-only subscriptions.

sources.name: United Church of God - Beyond Today
sources.optout_instructions: Publisher explicitly permits cancellation at any time; use your free account subscription settings or ask support at info@ucg.org to cancel the PRINT edition.
sources.notes: Select PRINT ONLY (free); quarterly; requires creation of a free account with postal address.

sources.name: Philadelphia Trumpet Magazine
sources.optout_instructions: The official FAQ explicitly permits cancellation of the PRINT subscription by mail to The Trumpet, PO Box 3700, Edmond OK 73083, or phone 1-800-772-8577.
sources.notes: Free printed magazine on religious and world events; renewals are voluntary and free.

sources.name: The Banner (Christian Reformed Church)
sources.optout_instructions: For the FREE print magazine, use the "Can We Help" subscription form or call 1-800-777-7270 to request removal of the PHYSICAL magazine subscription.
sources.notes: CAUTION: publisher says print sign-up also enrolls a WEEKLY EMAIL newsletter. Do not submit if you require absolutely no electronic marketing.

sources.name: The Voice of the Martyrs Magazine
sources.optout_instructions: The official VOM privacy policy says postal-mail communications are optional and you can opt out of POSTAL communications at any time by contacting the ministry.
sources.notes: CAUTION: magazine offer also enrolls periodic EMAIL updates and may bundle a free book; omit if strictly physical-mail-only consent is required. Phone optional to avoid SMS agreement.

sources.name: Billy Graham - Decision Free Six-Issue Offer
sources.optout_instructions: For communication and mailing-list preferences or postal cancellation, contact the Billy Graham Evangelistic Association privacy office at privacy@bgea.org, identify the 6-issue PRINT subscription and address.
sources.notes: FREE six-issue trial, US addresses only. Do not use regular PAID Decision subscription form instead.

sources.name: Hillsdale College - Imprimis
sources.optout_instructions: To cancel printed Imprimis, contact the official Imprimis subscriptions desk at imprimis@hillsdale.edu or 800-437-2268 and request removal from the PRINT mailing list.
sources.notes: Free print speech/policy digest. Choose MAIL rather than email or both; political opinion material (not an election-campaign circular).

sources.name: Freedom From Religion Foundation - Information Packet
sources.optout_instructions: The FFRF official privacy policy permits opt-out of marketing communications and other materials by CONTACTING FFRF; specify postal information packet/mailings.
sources.notes: FREE one-time postal brochure and complimentary Freethought Today issue, not a free ongoing membership. Select "Newspaper by mail"; ongoing newspaper normally requires paid membership.

sources.name: Institute for Justice - Liberty & Law
sources.optout_instructions: The IJ privacy policy explicitly lists POSTAL mail removal via its published email contact or by writing Donor Communications, Institute for Justice, 901 N. Glebe Rd. #901, Arlington VA 22203.
sources.notes: Free U.S. printed bimonthly newsletter. CAUTION: form also subscribes to digital IJ updates; skip if you do not consent to those emails.

sources.name: Christianbook (printed catalogs)
sources.optout_instructions: Ask Christianbook at customer.service@christianbook.com or 1-800-247-4784 to remove your FULL name and postal address from mailed Christianbook catalogs. Christianbook also publishes its Mail Preference Service postal address in the privacy notice.
sources.notes: The request page offers five types of free PRINT catalogs; pick only subjects of genuine interest. Print catalogs recur about monthly. Deselect optional email offers and list sharing if you do not want them.

sources.name: Lands' End (catalogs)
sources.optout_instructions: Lands' End officially says to call 1-800-963-4816 or email websiteinquiry@landsend.com for BOTH signup and cancellation of PHYSICAL catalogs. Provide name, physical address, and phone as requested; opt-out may take 2-4 weeks.
sources.notes: No current online catalog sign-up was verified. The subscribe URL opens official website; use PHONE or EMAIL from the official 2025 privacy policy. No purchases needed.

sources.name: Hammacher Schlemmer (paper catalog)
sources.optout_instructions: For PHYSICAL print catalog mailings, request removal from Hammacher Schlemmer using the marketing-communications opt-out contact information at https://hammacher.com/privacy (privacy@hammacher.com). Be explicit that you mean the postal catalog.
sources.notes: Official 2026 article instructs using "Get future catalogs in the mail" on the home page. Ensure you select PAPER catalog, not electronic Gnomenclature newsletter.

sources.name: Territorial Seed Company
sources.optout_instructions: Official privacy policy explicitly says to stop PRINTED catalogs by calling 1-800-626-0866 or emailing info@territorialseed.com. Processing may take 2-4 weeks.
sources.notes: The official catalogs page requests a U.S. postal address. Publication is seasonal; physical copies are free.

sources.name: Rainbow Resource Center
sources.optout_instructions: Official FAQ specifically instructs recipients to contact customer service at info@rainbowresource.com to have their name removed from the PHYSICAL catalog mailing list.
sources.notes: Free educational print catalogs by mail to U.S. addresses; some editions may be available through a checkout requiring a zero-dollar order.

sources.name: Bluestone Perennials
sources.optout_instructions: Its official privacy policy says to contact Bluestone with name, postal address and telephone number and ask to discontinue PRINTED periodic catalog mailings; service@bluestoneperennials.com / 800-852-5243.
sources.notes: Free twice-yearly printed catalog. The request form requires JavaScript; phone catalog requests are also offered.

sources.name: Lee Valley Tools
sources.optout_instructions: Under Catalog Mailing List Changes, Lee Valley publishes customerservice@leevalley.com for postal catalog mailing-list changes. Ask to STOP receiving mailed catalogs, provide name and address, and account number if any.
sources.notes: Official customer service page says request a free print catalog by emailing customer service. No one-click website form is promised.

sources.name: Convoy of Hope - Hope Quarterly
sources.optout_instructions: Its official privacy policy says to stop PHYSICAL postal newsletters by submitting the Contact Us form with name/address and cancellation request, emailing the organization, or calling (417) 823-8998.
sources.notes: Free physical print magazine limited to U.S. addresses. Form may require birthdate, email, and organization information; review carefully for fit. Phone is optional and may authorize fundraising contact.

sources.name: Heifer International - World Ark
sources.optout_instructions: Heifer FAQs explicitly say to request World Ark by sending name, mailing address, phone and email to info@heifer.org; to stop postal mail, email info@heifer.org with full postal address or call (855) 948-6437. Existing mail recipients can also use Direct Mail Preferences, which may ask for the mail code.
sources.notes: World Ark is a physically mailed magazine. The print request is via email to customer service, not an automatic website form. Telephone/email may be required. Do not make a donation merely to be added to a mailing list.

sources.name: High Country Gardens
sources.optout_instructions: Use the official High Country Gardens Unsubscribe From Our Print Mailing List form to stop seasonal PAPER catalogs; this does not change the email newsletter.
sources.notes: Free seasonal paper catalog signup; separate email newsletter is optional. Do not mistake the email signup coupon form for the postal form.

sources.name: Uncommon Goods
sources.optout_instructions: The official catalog signup page links to its printed catalog unsubscribe route; the support FAQ explains entering mailing-label information, including the blue catalog code if available. Contact help@uncommongoods.com for additional assistance.
sources.notes: The merchant says its catalog arrives in weeks and may be mailed 4-6 times per year. The signup form asks for email; leave the optional marketing email checkbox unchecked.

sources.name: Coyuchi
sources.optout_instructions: Use the published Catalog Opt-Out form on Coyuchi Catalog Preferences to stop printed catalogs to the listed mailing address.
sources.notes: One official page has separate postal Catalog Opt-In and Catalog Opt-Out forms. Do not select optional email/SMS marketing.

sources.name: POLYWOOD
sources.optout_instructions: Use POLYWOOD Catalog Opt-Out and supply contact details as printed on the latest catalog label; the merchant specifically lists print catalog opt-in and opt-out in its support materials.
sources.notes: The official Digital Catalogs page also links to a separate physical Catalog Signup form; ensure you choose the PRINT option, not a PDF-only catalog. The opt-out asks for matching label data.

sources.name: Herrschners
sources.optout_instructions: The merchant privacy policy documents the right to update or delete personal data by emailing privacy-request@herrschners.com; specify removal from all PHYSICAL catalog and postal marketing lists, with your exact postal name/address. Confirm with customer support if needed.
sources.notes: The catalog page explicitly offers a free printed paper catalog for U.S. addresses without purchase. Postal-specific cancellation is through privacy/contact support, not a separate postal web form.

sources.name: David Morgan
sources.optout_instructions: Email catalog@davidmorgan.com with name and mailing address to be removed from its physical printed catalog list; this is explicitly documented under Print Catalog in its privacy page.
sources.notes: The free U.S. printed catalog is ordered via the David Morgan Print Catalog item and a $0 checkout. Confirm the order total is zero and do not buy anything to get a catalog. Normally publishes two print catalogs per year.

sources.name: Gardener's Supply Company
sources.optout_instructions: Call (812) 260-2128 and ask to be removed from all postal catalog mailings, or contact support via the Email Us form; the official Contact Preferences page specifically publishes phone removal instructions.
sources.notes: Official paper catalog request page. Postal and email preferences are distinct. Requests to stop paper catalogs may take several mailing cycles.

description: U.S. free printed-postal materials with public official opt-out instructions; independently confirm the forms and current terms before submitting
